checks: OS Terrain 5 is updated every three months
OS Terrain 5 is a mid-resolution landscape model and must not be treated as sub-metre parcel truth
OS Net base-station coordinate standard errors are generally better than 0.008m plan and 0.020m height
OSTN15 links ETRS89 GNSS positions to OSGB36 National Grid
OSGM15 links GNSS heights to mean-sea-level based national height datums
OSGM15 Great Britain height standard error is stated as 0.008m excluding GNSS heighting error
WGS84 GNSS and OSGB36/ODN mapping use different coordinate and height systems
parcel elevation promotion requires an explicit OSTN15/OSGM15-compatible horizontal and vertical transform chain
promotion_rule: OS Terrain remains secondary; datum-consistent transformation is mandatory before elevation comparison.
